name: feature.campaign-connectors.nodes
description: Campaign Connectors node pack (sync honest-ON per the campaign gap plan C2) — `import-csv` (parse a platform CSV export onto the unified metric schema with dedup + computed fields) and `sync` (pull yesterday's metrics for every dispatched campaign through the Connections broker via ctx.ads — meta/google live; other platforms stay CSV-first with `connector_not_configured`). Over ctx.features['campaign-connectors'] + ctx.ads.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Connectors: Import CSV
nodes.description: Imports a platform CSV export into the campaign performance store (dedup by platform|campaign|adSet|date, computed metrics). Inputs: { orgId, csv, defaultPlatform?, campaignId? }. Output: { imported, deduped, invalid, issues }.

nodes.label: Connectors: Sync (live)
nodes.description: Pulls yesterday's metrics for every dispatched campaign of the platform through the acting user's connection (ctx.ads.getMetrics window 'yesterday'; 15-min cooldown; per-campaign best-effort). meta/google live; other platforms return `connector_not_configured` (CSV import is the path). Inputs: { orgId, platform }. Output: { outcome: 'synced'|'cooldown'|'no_dispatches', campaigns, imported, deduped, failures[] }.

nodes.label: Sync Segment → Ad Audience
nodes.description: Uploads a CRM saved segment as a hashed platform custom audience (ADR 0217): consent-checked, suppression-subtracted, SHA-256-hashed members via ctx.ads.syncAudience — behind the ads-audience approval gate (default require-approval; PII-adjacent). Inputs: { segmentId, platform: meta|google, adAccountId, audienceName? }. Output: { platformAudienceId, uploaded, excluded }.
